title: AMP+ (envelope curves and a tempo-synced hold on the AMP page)
author: JohanStache (with Claude); after the Analog Rytm's improved AMP page
description: The AMP envelope with five curves and a tempo-synced hold, per track. On the AMP page, FUNC + A picks the curve: STK (stock: linear attack, exponential decay), LIN (linear both ways: the decay ends where the stock is 40 dB down), EXP (swells in, then falls at once: snappy), LOG (quick rounded attack, the decay stays up then falls: round and full) or PNCH (the fastest attack, a full body then a quick fall: punchy, gated). FUNC + B sets the hold FREE (stock) or SYNC: HOLD picks one of sixteen note values from 1/64 to a bar at the project tempo (HOLD 127 stays NOTE). A detent a step, drawn at once. Holding FUNC shows the real curve shape with its name inverted and the hold mode, and the attack, hold and decay times in the title bar; a track on a curve or a synced hold keeps that picture. Shaped curves follow the knobs' full resolution, so an LFO on ATK or DEC moves smoothly. A track on STK with a free hold runs the stock code, unchanged. The settings live in RAM: every track starts on STK and FREE at power-on.
